players.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

last_injury.description: Strained left hamstring running out ground ball vs. White Sox on June 9. This was his 2nd hamstring strain in 2026 (first was May 3-19, only 15 days). Also had left fibula fracture in March 2026 Spring Training that was resolved before season. Activated from IL on July 27 after extended rehab assignment at Triple-A Gwinnett.

players.current_status: Active and playing regularly. Hit 200th career home run on September 4, 2026. Braves lead NL East by 4 games (83-57 record as of Sept 4).
notes: Second hamstring strain in 3 weeks after returning from first in May
Only player to hit 40+ HR in both 2019 and 2023 seasons
Career injuries include 2 ACL surgeries (2021 right, 2024 left)

players.name: Mookie Betts
players.position: Shortstop / Second Base / Third Base / Outfield

last_injury.description: Injured right oblique while running bases in first inning vs. Washington Nationals on April 4. MRI revealed mild oblique strain. Placed on 10-day IL on April 5. Had a minor setback in late April during BP. Started on-field progression with med ball throws in early May. Made 2 rehab starts with Triple-A Oklahoma City. Activated May 12, 2026, batting second in lineup vs. Giants. Optioned Alex Freeland to Triple-A OKC to make roster spot.

players.current_status: Active. Currently experiencing day-to-day stiff lower back since July 11, 2026 — NOT expected to go on IL. Also had right wrist soreness July 2 that resolved in 1 game. On a 7-game hit streak with .355 avg over last 15 games. Position: SS moving to multiple positions.
notes: Most injury-plagued recent stretch for any star player in memory
Had stomach illness in March 2025 losing ~25 lbs in 2 weeks
Also dealt with death of stepfather during illness period
Transitioned from Red Sox shortstop to Dodgers shortstop for 2025 season
Wore right wrist cast after pitching machine accident in March 2025

players.name: Freddie Freeman

last_injury.description: Fell down visiting dugout steps at Dodger Stadium while chasing foul pop-up vs. Kansas City Royals on August 12. No rail available. Fell through first flight of stairs, landed before second flight. Right side of body took brunt of impact. Did not hit head. Symptoms: sore kneecaps, shoulder, hand, and wrist. Cold tubbed immediately, no imaging required. Returned to lineup Thursday August 14 vs. Brewers. Also had HBP to right hand on August 5, 2026 vs. Cubs at Wrigley Field — X-rays negative, returned Friday.

players.current_status: Active and Healthy. No acute injuries. Body soreness from August 12 fall fully resolved as of August 18. Chronic ankle managed via load management. Playing regularly. Batted .310 at one point in August 2026, ranked 3rd in NL. Had 15-game hitting streak at one point. Shifted to #2 batting spot in lineup in August.

2026_season_stats.note: Stats from StatMuse and PitcherStat, through September 4, 2026

notes: Among most durable players in baseball — played 118 of Dodgers' 121 games in 2026
Chronic left ankle managed via rest/load management days
Fell into stands at Chase Field in Arizona (circa 2016) before protective netting was installed
2024 World Series run with fractured elbow — threw from foul territory
Also had neck stinger from August 2025 — resolved fully
